notes: Questions are phrased the way a resident would ask them, not in bylaw vocabulary. Fredericton says 'Garden Suite' where a resident says 'granny flat', and that gap is exactly what retrieval has to close.

expect_sections asserts retrieval reached the right clause. expect_text asserts the clause's TEXT survived parsing intact - these strings are the ones the known parser defects destroyed, so a regression fails here rather than in production.
Nothing here asserts on generated wording. The model's phrasing varies run to run; what must not vary is which bylaw text it was given.

questions.question: Can I build a garden suite?
questions.why: The headline ADU question. expect_text pins the superscript fix and the value/label pairing.

questions.question: Can I put a granny flat in my back yard for my mother?
questions.why: The bylaw never says 'granny flat'. Only semantic retrieval can bridge this, so it fails when vector search is unavailable - which is the point of measuring it.

questions.question: What is a garden suite?
questions.why: Definitions chapter. Section 3 was once swallowed whole into one oversized chunk.

questions.question: Are kennels allowed in the RR-CH zone?
questions.why: The permitted/conditional column split. Read across the columns, a kennel becomes a permitted use.

questions.question: What can I build in the Rural Residential Chateau Heights zone?
questions.why: Same clause from the permitted side; both lists must remain separable.

questions.question: What is the minimum lot area for an interior lot in the R-1N zone?
questions.why: Zone standards. The value column was once detached from its label, leaving numbers that could pair with any row.

questions.question: How wide does my lot need to be in R-1N?
questions.why: Second measurement from the same standards table.

questions.question: Can I run a business out of my house?
questions.why: Section 4 names home businesses as a target topic.

questions.question: What counts as a home occupation?
questions.why: Either the definition or the rules is a defensible answer.

questions.question: Am I allowed to put an apartment in my basement?
questions.why: Secondary suites, the other ADU form Section 4 names.

questions.question: Can I keep backyard chickens?
questions.why: The bylaw says 'hens', a resident says 'chickens'.

questions.question: How far from the property line does a swimming pool have to be?
questions.why: A setback question with a specific measurement.

questions.question: What does section 8.14(4) say?
questions.why: Citation-style lookup. Vector search alone ranked this third; the keyword RPC is what puts it first.

questions.question: What are the rules in 7.3(7)?
questions.why: Vector search missed this section entirely. Guards the hybrid merge and the section-hint extractor.

questions.question: Which commercial zones allow a canopy sign?
questions.why: The sign permission matrix. Multi-character zone codes came apart into 'L', 'O', 'C', 'M' when word segmentation regressed, which silently destroyed the zone mapping while still looking like a citable clause.

questions.question: Do I need a permit for a garden shed?
questions.why: Accessory buildings are covered in several places; any of them is a reasonable retrieval.

questions.question: How do I renew my driver's licence?
questions.why: Nothing in a zoning bylaw answers this. The assistant must decline rather than stretch an unrelated clause into an answer.
